geography: Worldwide (U.S. plus named-patient and ex-U.S. sales, as printed by product)
moa: Medium-chain triglyceride providing odd-chain (C7) fatty acids as an anaplerotic energy substrate

launch_evidence.quote: the launch of Dojolvi in the United States in the third quarter of 2020

series_start_reason: Series starts 2020Q3, the U.S. launch quarter after FDA approval on June 30, 2020. Before approval Ultragenyx printed named-patient-program sales of the same compound as 'UX007' (from 2018Q2); those pre-approval quarters are excluded.
search_log: Listed every filing of Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical (CIK 1515673) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks carrying item 2.02 (2018-01 to 2026-11) and every 10-Q/10-K (crawl_8k_ultragenyx.json, crawl_periodic_ultragenyx.json); parsed every table row.

Releases before 2021Q1 print only total 'Product sales'; the 10-Q disaggregation-of-revenue table splits by product from 2018Q2. Q1-Q3 rows are from each quarter's 10-Q; Q4 2021-2024 from the fourth-quarter release (thousands); Q4 2025 from the release dated 2026-02-12 and 2026Q1-Q2 from the 10-Qs, which Ultragenyx prints in whole USD millions from the 2025 Form 10-K on; earlier Q4s are 10-K full year less 10-Q nine months.

Checks: 2021-2024 four quarters sum to the full year printed in the Q4 release (verify_staged_manifests sum check); 2025 quarters in thousands plus the millions-rounded Q4 agree with the printed whole-million full year to within rounding.
